## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos`
- [ ] Unit and widget tests
- [ ] Android release build
- [ ] iOS simulator build when iOS code changes
- [ ] Existing-data migration or rollback path reviewed
- [ ] Primary actions verified above Android/iOS system UI
- [ ] Keyboard and large-text behavior checked for changed forms

## Data and privacy

- [ ] Existing workout history is preserved
- [ ] Backup, restore, import, and export include new persistent fields
- [ ] AI remains optional and uses only enabled data domains
- [ ] No unsupported causal, diagnostic, or medical claims were added

## Product voice

- [ ] User-facing copy follows `docs/PRODUCT_VOICE.md`
- [ ] Established terminology is used consistently
- [ ] Copy avoids guilt, body shame, forced hype, and forced slang
- [ ] Errors explain what happened and what the user can do next
- [ ] Gemini prompt or output changes follow the same voice and evidence rules

## Screenshots or recordings

Add visual evidence for user-facing changes.
